title: Detailed palm tree
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='trunk' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#8a5a2b'/>
      <stop offset='0.5' stop-color='#b8824a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#7a4a22'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='leaf1' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#7ee06b'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#2f9b3a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='leaf2' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#9bf07e'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#3fb84a'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- ground sand -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='93' rx='38' ry='7' fill='#e8c56a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='91.5' rx='34' ry='5' fill='#f2d888'/>

  <!-- trunk -->
  <path d='M47 90 Q44 70 46 52 Q47 40 50 30 L56 30 Q54 42 53 52 Q52 70 53 90 Z' fill='url(#trunk)'/>
  <!-- trunk rings -->
  <path d='M45 84 Q50 86 54.5 84' stroke='#6b3f1b' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M45.4 78 Q50 80 54.3 78' stroke='#6b3f1b' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M45.6 72 Q50 74 54 72' stroke='#6b3f1b' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M46 66 Q50 68 53.6 66' stroke='#6b3f1b' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M46.3 60 Q50 62 53.4 60' stroke='#6b3f1b' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M46.6 54 Q50 56 53.2 54' stroke='#6b3f1b' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M47 48 Q50 50 53 48' stroke='#6b3f1b' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M47.4 42 Q50 44 52.8 42' stroke='#6b3f1b' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M48 36 Q50 38 52.5 36' stroke='#6b3f1b' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- trunk highlight -->
  <path d='M50 88 Q49 70 50 52 Q51 42 52.5 32' stroke='#d9a86a' stroke-width='1' fill='none' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- coconuts -->
  <circle cx='47' cy='33' r='3' fill='#6b3f1b'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='33' r='3' fill='#6b3f1b'/>
  <circle cx='50.5' cy='36' r='2.8' fill='#5a3416'/>

  <!-- fronds -->
  <!-- left drooping -->
  <path d='M50 30 Q30 12 8 22 Q28 20 46 30 Z' fill='url(#leaf1)'/>
  <path d='M50 30 Q30 12 8 22' stroke='#256b2c' stroke-width='0.8' fill='none'/>
  <!-- upper left -->
  <path d='M50 30 Q34 5 16 6 Q36 12 48 28 Z' fill='url(#leaf2)'/>
  <!-- top -->
  <path d='M50 30 Q50 2 44 1 Q50 10 50 28 Z' fill='url(#leaf1)'/>
  <path d='M50 30 Q52 2 58 1 Q52 10 51 28 Z' fill='url(#leaf2)'/>
  <!-- upper right -->
  <path d='M52 30 Q66 5 86 8 Q64 12 54 28 Z' fill='url(#leaf1)'/>
  <!-- right drooping -->
  <path d='M53 31 Q72 14 94 26 Q72 22 55 31 Z' fill='url(#leaf2)'/>
  <path d='M53 31 Q72 14 94 26' stroke='#256b2c' stroke-width='0.8' fill='none'/>
  <!-- lower right frond -->
  <path d='M53 32 Q74 30 90 44 Q70 36 53 33 Z' fill='url(#leaf1)'/>
  <!-- lower left frond -->
  <path d='M47 32 Q26 30 12 44 Q30 36 47 33 Z' fill='url(#leaf2)'/>
  <!-- small mid fronds -->
  <path d='M48 30 Q36 22 26 24 Q38 24 47 30 Z' fill='#4fd05a'/>
  <path d='M52 30 Q64 22 74 24 Q62 24 53 30 Z' fill='#4fd05a'/>

  <!-- frond midribs / veins -->
  <path d='M50 30 Q34 16 18 20' stroke='#256b2c' stroke-width='0.6' fill='none' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M50 30 Q38 12 26 10' stroke='#256b2c' stroke-width='0.6' fill='none' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M52 30 Q64 14 76 12' stroke='#256b2c' stroke-width='0.6' fill='none' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M53 31 Q68 20 82 24' stroke='#256b2c' stroke-width='0.6' fill='none' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
